description: This file contains asynchronous service functions for managing notes, tags, and users in a notes application. It includes CRUD operations, search, tag management, and utility functions for handling database interactions with SQLAlchemy ORM. The functions are designed to be used as part of an API backend built with FastAPI.

methods.name: List[Tag] _get_or_create_tags( session: AsyncSession, *, user_id: uuid.UUID, tag_names: List[str] )
methods.description: Fetch existing tags or create new ones for a user, handling normalization and deduplication.

methods.name: List[str] _note_to_tag_names(note: Note)
methods.description: Convert a Note object to a list of its associated tag names.

methods.name: Note _get_note_or_404(session: AsyncSession, *, user_id: uuid.UUID, note_id: uuid.UUID)
methods.description: Retrieve a note by ID for a specific user, raising 404 if not found.

methods.name: Note create_note( session: AsyncSession, *, user: User, title: str, content: str, content_markdown: str, tags: List[str] )
methods.description: Public interface to create a new note with optional tags for a user.

methods.name: Note get_note(session: AsyncSession, *, user: User, note_id: uuid.UUID)
methods.description: Fetch a specific note for a user by note ID.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Note],int] list_notes( session: AsyncSession, *, user: User, offset: int, limit: int, tag: Optional[str], archived: Optional[bool], )
methods.description: List notes for a user with optional filtering by tags and archived status, supporting pagination.

methods.name: Note update_note( session: AsyncSession, *, user: User, note_id: uuid.UUID, title: Optional[str], content: Optional[str], content_markdown: Optional[str], archived: Optional[bool], tags: Optional[List[str]], )
methods.description: Update fields and tags of a user's note.

methods.name: None delete_note(session: AsyncSession, *, user: User, note_id: uuid.UUID)
List[Tag] list_tags(session: AsyncSession, *, user: User)
methods.description: List all tags associated with a user.

methods.name: None delete_tag(session: AsyncSession, *, user: User, tag_id: uuid.UUID)
methods.description: Delete a specific tag for a user, including associations.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Note],int] search_notes( session: AsyncSession, *, user: User, query: str, offset: int, limit: int, )
methods.description: Search notes for a user using full-text search and fallback trigram filtering, with pagination.

methods.name: None ensure_user_email_unique(session: AsyncSession, *, email: str)
methods.description: Ensure a user's email is unique; raise conflict error if not.
